incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: P4502 fired for model-catalog-service — high tokenizer error rate (>= 10% of generation requests). Auto-escalation to eng-oncall. https://pd.example/p/alerts/P4502

pagerduty: Alert details: summary="catalog: revision autopromote produced mismatched tokenizer config" severity=high, service=model-catalog, triggered_by=autopromote-pipeline

jordan: acked. i'm on it. grabbing pager (P4502).

alex: i can help with immediate routing rollback. is there an obvious bad revision in the catalog? i saw a noisy deploy earlier but didnt dig in.

marta: logs show tokenizer mismatch errors from runtime: `TokenizerVocabError: vocab size 50258 != model expected 50260` — this is consistent with a wrong tokenizer being attached to new revision r2026-03-12-01.

ryan: timeline: autopromote pipeline ran at 2939991000 -> promoted model rev r2026-03-12-01 into production variants. Errors start ~2939991050 and ramped to ~12% error rate across a subset of 12k requests/min.

jordan: impact: ~12% error rate on text-generation endpoints for customers on region-us-west. Some retries masking it, but latency also increased. tentative severity=sev2 until rollback.

alex: small mitigation: we can override routing to pin to previous revision r2026-03-11-14 for all customers in us-west. doing `redwoodctl route update --model catalog:model-a --variant default --pin-revision r2026-03-11-14 --region us-west`

marta: +1. also need to block autopromote for the pipeline until we root-cause the tokenizer mapping. set `autopromote.enabled=false` for that model in catalog.

emma: i'm running the rollback command now and will monitor tokenization errors. posting logs:
```
$ redwoodctl route update --model catalog:model-a --variant default --pin-revision r2026-03-11-14 --region us-west
Status: OK
Routing update applied.  Traffic shifted ~4s ago.
```

emma: monitoring metrics — error-rate dropping from 12% -> 1.6% in the last 30s for region-us-west. :white_check_mark:

jordan: nice. can someone check the catalog entry that triggered autopromote? we need the metadata that mapped tokenizer -> revision. suspect broken manifest or CI step that mutated tokenizer field.

marta: catalog dump snippet (excerpt):
```
model: model-a
revision: r2026-03-12-01
tokenizer: s3://tokenizers/model-a/vocab-50258.json   # <-- this doesn't match model binary (expects vocab-50260)
autopromote: true
```

ryan: looks like the tokenizer artifact in the build pipeline was replaced by a smaller vocab file. CI/test should have caught mismatched vocab size but our model onboarding tests skipped that model (edge case). i'll open a follow-up to add strict validation.

alex: for immediate customer comms: should we inform affected customers about transient errors and rollback? ops/success should prepare a short note: "We observed elevated generation errors in us-west; we've rolled back to previous model revision and are investigating root cause. No prompt data was exposed."

jordan: agreed. @emma can you create a postmortem ticket and link PD alert? i'll start the incident timeline.

emma: created INC-2026-317 in tracker, added timeline, retention window, and assigned to marta/ryan for root cause. link: https://tracker.example/INC-2026-317

marta: next steps: 1) block autopromote for model-a; 2) run a small binary vs tokenizer validation script against staged artifacts; 3) revert faulty tokenizer on s3 or re-run build to produce correct vocab; 4) add a fast CI check for vocab size match to model header.

ryan: i'm drafting the CI patch now (quick check script). will push a PR and ask eng-ml for review. ETA 2hrs for initial PR.

alex: i'll leave the rollback pinned until we confirm correct artifact. jordan — handing off to you for the rest of the oncall window. i'm off in 20.

jordan: thanks. i'll monitor for 30m and then hand to next oncall if stable. current status: routing pinned to r2026-03-11-14 in us-west, error rate back to baseline (~0.5%), autopromote disabled for model-a, INC-2026-317 opened.

pagerduty: Alert P4502 manually acknowledged by jordan at 2939991120.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident action summary: rollback applied, autopromote disabled, RCA ticket created. Please add follow-ups for CI tests and release gating.

emma: quick note: if anyone needs to reproduce, use `redwoodctl catalog get model-a --revision r2026-03-12-01 --output json` and inspect `tokenizer.vocab_size`.

marta: will take lead on artifact re-build. assigning to myself in INC-2026-317.

jordan: OK handing off now to ryan for daytime coverage. ryan, escalate to eng-ml if rebuild fails.

ryan: ACK. monitoring dashboards and alerting for 2 hours. will post updates in thread.

emma: closing PD alert thread once we confirm 30m stable. current last_message_ts=2939991159

alex: thanks all. good triage. :thumbsup:
